chunks: And through this chain of narration, from Hanan ibn Sadeer, who said:

We heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: 'The enemy of Ali (peace be upon him) will not leave this world until he drinks a gulp from Hellfire.' And he said: 'It is the same for whoever opposes this command, whether he prays or fasts.'
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of enmity towards Imam Ali (a.s.) on a person's afterlife and worship?
ai.summary: Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him) declares that the enemy of Imam Ali (peace be upon him) will not depart this world without drinking a gulp of Hellfire, emphasizing that en masse, highlighting the severity of their spiritual state. He clarifies that this enmity nullifies the merit of other acts of worship, such as prayer and fasting, rendering their ritual observance ineffective regardless of whether they performed them or not. This underscores the Shia doctrine that *Wilayah* (divine authority) is the foundational key to the acceptance of all other deeds.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 17.  It is narrated that Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.) said, “As soon as the enemy of Ali (a.s.) passes away from this world, he is made to drink a gulp of the boiling water of Hell. For one  who  is  inimical  to  Ali  (a.s.)  there  is  no  difference whether he is a worshipper or a fornicator.”
